pb-hypernode-mcp.description: Hypernode Brancher MCP server — brancher_create/list/delete/ssh_info/exec/put tools for spinning up disposable prod-clone preview environments. Requires HYPERNODE_API_TOKEN set in the environment before Claude Code starts (read from env only, never written to disk or stored in plugin config). Optional HYPERNODE_APP_ALLOWLIST (comma-separated) restricts which Hypernode <appname> values these tools may target.
